parameters.name: DeliveryName
parameters.description: The name of the log delivery configuration.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the WAF instance. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-log-delivery-config --instance-id waf_elasticity-00000 --delivery-name test1 --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
